## Interactive 3D Topographic Map

Here is a 3D surface plot showing the topographic information of Maunga Whau (Mt Eden) volcano. Click and drag to rotate the plot!

```{r, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
# Load the plotly library
library(plotly)

# Generate a 3D surface plot using the built-in 'volcano' matrix
fig <- plot_ly(z = ~volcano, type = "surface")

# Add a title to the layout
fig <- fig %>% layout(title = "Elevation Map of Maunga Whau")

# Display the interactive plot
fig
